ctx.x: You know, Les Lieber. So Les Lieber was on that bill. And he was playing his penny whistle there. In fact, on the air when the program came on, Paul Douglas would say, "The Saturday Night Swing Club is now is session." So Columbia decided to put this on the stage at Loew's State.
